data.title: XRP ETFs Beat Bitcoin, Ethereum Inflows: What Is Going On?
data.description: XRP (CRYPTO: XRP) spot ETFs pulled in $18.98 million this week while Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) and Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) ETFs bled a combined $479 million in outflows.What the ETF Flow Data ShowsU.S. spot XRP ETFs recorded inflows of $1.55 million on September 8, $12.29 million on September 9, and $5…
